Choose likely correct one: The amide formation from carboxylic acid and amine. Template likely has pattern: [#7:2]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])... i.e., amide to acid? The retro template would break amide to acid + amine. The canonical forward template is amide formation. The retro smarts likely is amide -> acid + amine. Look at template 659569: retro_smarts_template: '[#7:5]-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])-[C:3]=[C:4]>>O-[C;H0;D3;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])-[C:3]=[C:4]'. This is amide attached to alkene? Our target has amide attached to aromatic ring and conjugated double bond (C= C). The amide is attached to C(=O)N attached to aromatic ring and also to a C=C (alpha,beta unsaturated). The template 659569 seems to handle amide attached to alkene (C= C). Might match.
